description: The user is on a car's page and asks about damage and accident history. The agent reads the car's own page with vehicle_details and shows its condition and imperfections, saying where each fact comes from.

turns.message: Has this one been in an accident? Any damage I should know about?

events.text:
No accident is reported: Carvana says the AutoCheck report shows none, and its CARFAX-based tag says there was one previous owner.

Carvana's inspectors photographed three imperfections: a light scratch on the front bumper, visible past repair work on the rear bumper, and a scratch on a hard surface in the trunk. In the 150-point inspection on Oct 21, 11 items were fixed or replaced, including the rear bumper, the wheels and the spare tire.

sections.name: condition
sections.summary: No accident on the AutoCheck report Carvana uses.

lines.meta: This vehicle has no reported accidents, fire, flood, or frame damage according to CARFAX™ and AutoCheck®.
This vehicle’s CarFax history report shows it has had only one previous owner.
This car is priced at least $1,500 below its Kelley Blue Book® Suggested Retail Value.

lines.text: Under the hood: Wheels/Rims (check for damage); Spare tire (or inflator kit)
Interior: Steering wheel tilt/lock; Luggage compartment (jack and tool present)
How it looks: Driver’s side (front/rear); Passenger side (front/rear); Rear bumper condition
Detailing: Complete premium detail (wash, wax and high speed buff); Complete premium interior detail including odor test; Clean engine compartment; Clean all windows
Warranty left: basic 2 mo or 9,800 mi; drivetrain 50 mo or 79,800 mi; battery 50 mo or 59,800 mi

lines.meta: Scratches in the clear coat that are clearly visible with virtually no depth. A fingernail won't catch on the scratch.

components.text: Estimated total adds Carvana's estimated taxes and fees to the price. Final amounts are set at checkout.
